relationship_description: Akmad B. Ampatuan is a member of the Ampatuan clan, which is led by Andal Ampatuan Sr.; multiple family members hold political office in Maguindanao.
Akmad Sangki is the son of Ali Sangki, a prominent member of the Sangki clan in Maguindanao.
Ali Sangki is a cousin of Andal Ampatuan Sr., linking the Sangki and Ampatuan dynasties in Maguindanao.
